findings.title: Site is not served over HTTPS
findings.why: Browsers label HTTP pages 'Not secure' at checkout, and search engines favour HTTPS.
findings.fix: Install a TLS certificate and redirect every HTTP request to HTTPS.

findings.title: Important pages are set to noindex
findings.why: These pages are in the sitemap but tell search engines not to index them.
findings.fix: Remove noindex from pages meant to rank, or drop them from the sitemap.

findings.title: Images without alt text
findings.why: Screen-reader users hear nothing, and image search has no description to index.
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text to product and content images; use alt="" only for decoration.

findings.title: Broken internal links
findings.why: Dead links waste crawl budget and send shoppers to error pages.
findings.fix: Fix or redirect each link; add redirects when products are removed.

findings.title: Broken structured data
findings.why: Search engines ignore JSON-LD that fails to parse.
findings.fix: Fix the JSON syntax in the theme snippet.

findings.title: Product pages without Product schema
findings.why: Without it products are not eligible for price and availability in search results.
findings.fix: Output Product JSON-LD with name, image, offers.price, priceCurrency and availability.

findings.title: Render-blocking scripts in <head>
findings.why: The browser stops drawing the page until each one downloads and runs.
findings.fix: Add defer or async, or move the script to the end of the body.

findings.title: Duplicate meta descriptions
findings.why: Identical snippets make pages compete with each other in search.
findings.fix: Make each meta description specific to the page.
evidence: 'a perfectly reasonable description for this page of the stor' on 5 pages: https://fake-pies.example/, https://fake-pies.example/products/good-pie, https://fake-pies.example/collections/all

findings.title: Pages with more than one H1
findings.why: Several H1s blur the page's main topic.
findings.fix: Keep one H1 and demote the rest to H2/H3.

findings.title: Missing language attribute
findings.why: Screen readers and translation tools cannot tell which language the page is in.
findings.fix: Set <html lang="..."> in the theme layout.

findings.title: Pages without a meta description
findings.why: Search engines then improvise a snippet, often from navigation text.
findings.fix: Write a 70-160 character description for each template and key page.

findings.title: Titles too short or too long
findings.why: Titles under 15 characters waste the slot; over 70 get cut off in results.
findings.fix: Keep titles roughly 30-60 characters with the product or topic first.
